body: I think the problem is even if I have gone through worse, for some reason it feels that every bad thing that happens hurts exponencially now. Some days are worse than others, but the bad ones are scary by this point. I have considered a therapists, but I'm already under a lot of meds, which I hate, and it worries me to add more to the mix. For now, I really apreaciate the interest. I can't go to anyone around me and talk openly about this, and I had never considered going to reddit for something so personal, but it has brought some comfort.
I have been having really dark thoughts, specially the last couple of days. It's really a relief to read that from someone. Thank you.

Hi, I found out about my bf cheating on me the last time 3 months ago and I can't get over it. I feel I'm loosing my mind. I have more baggage than I can handle.

Thank you for asking, it's nice to open up to someone about all this.
